title: phpolars
summary: phpolars is a PHP extension, written in Rust, that brings the Polars data frame engine to PHP. It follows the py-polars API: DataFrame, LazyFrame, Series, and expressions, with lazy queries, time series windows, joins, SQL, and readers for CSV, Parquet, JSON, and Arrow IPC. Queries run on Polars' multithreaded engine. It is also the engine behind phibble's PolarsTable, so phplyr pipelines can run in Polars.
requires: PHP 8.3, 8.4, or 8.5 (NTS) on Linux or macOS
Prebuilt binaries for Linux with glibc 2.34+ on x86_64 and arm64; elsewhere PIE builds from source with Rust and libclang

vignettes.title: Lazy queries over a large file
vignettes.summary: Scan a Parquet or CSV file with up to 5 million rows, let Polars push the filter and column selection into the scan, and compare the time with reading the whole file first.

vignettes.title: phplyr pipelines on Polars
vignettes.summary: Run one phplyr pipeline on phibble's in-memory DataFrame and on a PolarsTable, check that the results agree, and compare the times.

vignettes.title: Rolling windows and asof joins
vignettes.summary: Price a year of daily sales with an asof join, smooth it with a time-based rolling mean, and summarize it by month or quarter.
